sentences.en: In culture, they are on the same plane as savages.
sentences.zh: 在文化上，他们与野蛮人处于同一水平。

sentences.en: We have to transmit our culture to the next generation.
sentences.zh: 我们必须把我们的文化传承给下一代。

sentences.en: It's very difficult to communicate with people from other cultures.
sentences.zh: 与其他文化的people沟通非常困难。

senses.zh: 文化 - 修养, 教养, 精神文明 - 养殖, 培养, 栽培 -
